messages:
Ivy (docs): Quick FYI 1 saw three small but user-facing issues in the API reference: 1) /generate examples use the request param "model" in examples but the schema was changed to "model_id" last year, so copy/paste samples hit validation errors. 2) the streaming SSE example shows raw JSON lines without the required 'data:' prefix, which breaks EventSource clients. 3) upload curl snippet still omits an explicit multipart boundary so it fails when pasted into some shells.

Sam (eng-runtime): ugh, thanks for catching. Do you have the exact file/lines? We can patch docs-only if there's no runtime change.

Ivy (docs): YAML refs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/blob/main/openapi/generate.yaml#L102-L128 and streaming example: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/blob/main/reference/streaming.md#sse-example The SDK generator reproduces the bad request since it uses the examples as canonical shapes.

Noah (sdk): we see this when the example key doesn't match the schema. Our sample-gen will produce a request with "model" if the example shows it, which fails server-side. So docs fix -> downstream SDK samples fixed.

Ivy (docs): Proposed quick fixes I can PR: - replace all example request bodies to use "model_id": "rwd-13b" - fix SSE doc to show proper framing: e.g. ```
data: {"event":"delta","chunk":"hello"}

``` - add explicit boundary example for curl and a Node fetch + FormData snippet for uploads. Example curl: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/upload" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=----RedwoodBoundary42" \ 
  --data-binary $'------RedwoodBoundary42\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename="foo.txt"\r\nContent-Type: text/plain\r\n\r\nhello\r\n------RedwoodBoundary42--'
```

Sam (eng-runtime): SGTM. Please add a one-line note in docs/migration.md stating that examples were normalized from "model" to "model_id" to match the current API schema so integrators relying on copy/paste should update keys. No API or runtime change.

Noah (sdk): also please include an EventSource client snippet that demonstrates parsing SSE 'data:' payloads and a Node example with FormData so the SDK sample-tests pass.

Ivy (docs): Will do. I'll open a small PR that updates examples, streaming doc, upload snippets and migration note. Will include both curl and Node snippets and a tiny test vector.

bot-docs: PR #5310 opened by ivy: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5310 - normalizes example request param to "model_id", fixes SSE framing in streaming.md, adds explicit multipart boundary curl example and Node FormData/EventSource snippets, adds migration note. CI: docs-lint OK, sample-tests running.

Noah (sdk): kicked the sample-tests. Looks good locally, should be fine once CI finishes.

Sam (eng-runtime): CI green -> merging. Merged PR #5310 (commit 5a7b9c). Deployed to staging docs-staging.redwood-inference.dev.

Priya (pm): Thanks, team. Confirming this was docs-only and safe for customers. We'll include a short blurb in the weekly changelog so integrators see the small example normalization.

Ivy (docs): Verified staging examples and SDK sample output. Closing the docs issue. :white_check_mark:
